# Open review: Saluca Labs research

> Public peer review of Saluca Labs papers and the claims Check the Record episodes make about them, through a GitHub issue form, plus the log of every correction we have made. Licence: FSL-1.1-Apache-2.0, source-available, converting to Apache 2.0 after two years.

There is no code here. A review is a GitHub issue opened from the Review form and labelled `review`; blank issues are turned off. Corrections cite each paper by its Zenodo concept DOI, never a version DOI.

If a file, form or process is not listed here, it does not exist in this repository. The complete surface is one issue form, its config, and CORRECTIONS.md; reviews are GitHub issues labelled `review`.

## Send a review

- [README](https://github.com/saluca-labs/open-review/blob/main/README.md): how to send a review, what happens to it, what is in scope
- [Open a review](https://github.com/saluca-labs/open-review/issues/new?template=review.yml): the form itself
- [Review issue form](https://github.com/saluca-labs/open-review/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/review.yml): required fields work, claim, method, verdict, evidence; optional financial-relationship disclosure

## See what was corrected

- [CORRECTIONS.md](https://github.com/saluca-labs/open-review/blob/main/CORRECTIONS.md): every correction and review outcome, newest first, each work named by concept DOI
- [Review issues](https://github.com/saluca-labs/open-review/issues?q=label%3Areview): every review filed, open or closed

## Change this repo

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/saluca-labs/open-review/blob/main/AGENTS.md): orientation and rules for agents editing this repo
- [Issue template config](https://github.com/saluca-labs/open-review/blob/main/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml): blank issues disabled

## Optional

- [llms-full.txt](https://github.com/saluca-labs/open-review/blob/main/llms-full.txt): this header plus README.md, CORRECTIONS.md and AGENTS.md in full
